calibration_scope.runtime_default: Fixed scalar feature map; Bonferroni alpha allocation across all configured contexts and scores.
calibration_scope.known_context_replay: One trusted active context; alpha allocated across its score monitors only, with no combined false-alarm bound across context changes.

controlled_shift.name: estimated-channel amplitude multiplied by 1.5
controlled_shift.purpose: Pipeline diagnostic only; not a physical-channel benchmark or formal power guarantee.

limitations: Anytime marginal false-alarm control assumes the fixed score map and independent calibration and frame-level stream observations are i.i.d. under the null.
No shift alarm does not certify receiver accuracy.
Validation has only 15 samples per regime and cannot establish the advertised false-alarm probability empirically.
A context-specific reference must be selected using independently trusted context; feature-inferred context does not inherit this guarantee.
